name: Google Slides (read-write)
description: Google Slides, read and edit (scope presentations): presentations.create, get, batchUpdate (slides, shapes, text, images, tables, comments, …); pages.get and pages.getThumbnail. A thumbnail comes back as a contentUrl on a Google image host that drawlatch doesn't fetch; anyone holding that URL can open the image for about 30 minutes. Reaches every presentation the Google account can open, not just chosen ones; no Drive endpoints, so it cannot share, move, export, or delete files. Auth: drawlatch mints short-lived access tokens from GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET and GOOGLE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN (user OAuth; the agent never sees them) and refuses any token broader than this scope. See CONNECTIONS.md "Google (scoped)".

testConnection.description: Reads the ID of the public sample presentation from Google's Slides API quickstart (needs the Slides API enabled)
